description: Cached x402 endpoint observations, operated by SpendPreflight. Returns a transparent score (or unknown), its components and seven-day unpaid probe history for an already publicly listed URL. Never fetches the caller's URL or pays the endpoint. Unlisted, unavailable or stale data is not charged. This is not a paid-delivery or compliance guarantee. Provide the exact resource URL; add method when the URL has multiple advertised methods. Use for endpoint history and price context before paying. Use check_payee for wallet/name screening or preflight_payment for an allow/hold/block decision. Price $0.005 per cached lookup (shared free trial first). An unknown score means missing evidence; repeated paid calls may incur another charge.

method.description: Advertised method such as GET or POST; required if the URL is ambiguous

url.description: Exact public HTTP(S) URL already listed by Bazaar or x402scan
